title: A New Order for the Universe
front_description: In the Council chamber of the Jedi Temple, Mace Windu, Obi-Wan and Yoda discuss the new Galactic conflict. As for their "victory" against Dooku, Yoda remains skeptical. "The shroud of the dark side has fallen." he tells his comrades. "Begun, the Clone War has!" And on the balcony overlooking an enormous military staging area, Chancellor Palpatine, Bail Organa and Mas Amedda watch as the Republic's newly-created clone troopers march to war.
back_description: Dermot Power's costume design of the enigmatic Chancellor Palpatine.
